task_success_rule: native OpenDoorTask predicate_sequence with unchanged YAML threshold
camera_alignment: obs[t] before action[t], next_obs[t] after action[t]

supplementary_observer.purpose: Wide supplementary physical RGB view of robot, obstacle and microwave; original three camera poses and images retained.
supplementary_observer.scope: Supplementary real RGB sensor synchronized before the same action; no collision or physical state changes. Native cameras retained.

variant_spec.name: glass
variant_spec.semantic_anchor: One manually adjusted original tablet in the accepted approach channel; raise8mm while retaining full door sweep. Thin geometry rather than resizing. Source and static review required.

support.name: property_pedestal
support.source_support: Intended source floor support; independent geometry validation pending.

pregrasp_validation.checks: cuRobo constraints and independent FCL planning clearances at all dense samples

delivery_gate_note: Collector completion alone is not full acceptance; independent scene, causal, geometry, paired planning and video gates required.

review_gates.notes: Diagnostic motion thresholds do not replace the original strict OpenDoorTask success predicate or source safety margins. Neutral tolerances apply from the first post-reset observation, including startup. Task label resolved for this new trial; shared diagnostic tolerances are distinct from source success predicates.

contact_units: Native PhysX get_contact_data(dt=physics_dt): normal forces in N, points/separation in m; signed normals preserved.
recording_start: Immediately after source env.reset; no additional unrecorded settling. Source reset internals are outside the recorded trial.
contact_localization_scope: PhysX finger-to-door body filter plus bounds computed from source collision mesh vertices, not authored USD extents; independent source-shape distance audit required.
